title: Global Sea Surface Currents and Temperature
description: Ocean surface currents from the ECCO2 model on a flat global map, with each flow line coloured by sea surface temperature.
highlights: Warm equatorial bands lift the melody
Swirling eddies add texture and notes
A global map: drapes onto the globe
